import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    digits = []
    while m != 0:
        digits.append(m % w)
        m //= w
    ok = True
    for i in range(len(digits)):
        if digits[i] == 0 or digits[i] == 1:
            continue
        if digits[i] == w - 1:
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(digits):
                if digits[j] == w - 1:
                    digits[j] = 0
                else:
                    digits[j] += 1
                    break
                j += 1
            continue
        ok = False
        break
    if ok:
        print("YES")
    else:
        print("NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
